name: web-grid-system-with-column-overlay-on-phone-and-italic-serif-headline
title: Grid System Columns over a Phone
whatItIs: A pale page with a Grid System pill and a headline mixing light sans and bold italic serif, and a tall phone with translucent grey column bars over the screen, dimensions in italic serif above and below.
whatItMeans: Overlaying columns on a real screen makes the grid tangible, and italic serif measurements feel refined.
techniques: Translucent column bars over a real screen
Blue-grey gradient fading up from the phone base
Centred layout on a white page

vocabulary.definition: Semi-transparent bars showing layout columns over a design.
Outer space and space between columns.
